referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A soft teal-lavender clinic opening pairs a large plain-language promise with an appointment form sidecar and synthetic numerical proof. Dark emergency information strip above a white clinic menu and teal booking action. High-legibility contemporary sans with heavy service headers, compact form labels and small patient-info terms. White, pale cool gray, teal and lavender skyline overlay. One CC0 skyline hero image and flat placeholder clinician panels; the body depends on service icons and clear forms. The full sequence runs from clinic utility strip to split promise and booking form to six-service directory toward clinician placeholders, insurance list, patient FAQ and hours. All provider identities, wait times, ratings, insurance acceptance, clinic address, services and emergency availability are fictional.
